current_state: Newly implemented in chittyconnect and open as PR #309. Not yet propagated to other repos. Replaces a file-existence-only check that proved the config was present but never ran it.
rationale: OVERRIDE of the computed disposition local-only (scripts/audit_artifact.py). The script scored environmental_footprint admin-system(5) via FOOTPRINT_RULES keyword match on 'secret'/'config'/'auth' appearing in the artifact description, then routed 5 -> local-only. Per references/decision-matrix.md, footprint 5 is defined as 'changes auth, secrets, config, infra, deployment, or policy'. This artifact changes NONE of those: it is a GitHub-hosted Actions job with contents:read that downloads a version-pinned gitleaks 8.21.2 binary, scans the commits introduced by the change, and exits 0 or 1. It reads a repository and returns a verdict. Honest footprint is network-service(3). The matrix's local-only line requires 'local filesystem, device state, metadata preservation, or high privilege' — none apply. local-only would additionally defeat the artifact's entire purpose, which is to run in CI across many repositories. Existing-first search performed per the skill's core rule: capabilities.generated.json (106 capabilities) contains no secret-scanning or leak-detection capability, so this is a genuinely new job-to-be-done and promote is correct rather than merge or project. Evidentiary risk is low, not none: the gate verdict is an internal productivity/compliance artifact, but it is not a business record.
next_action: Merge PR #309, then propagate as a separate step. Packaging it as a skill under plugins/chittyos-governance is the distribution mechanism and does NOT by itself install the workflow in other repos.
